entities.description: A red car with a glossy finish is shown from the side, with the driver's side window open. Inside, a young man with curly brown hair is driving, wearing a white dress shirt and a green tie, while a young woman with long black hair sits in the passenger seat, also wearing a white dress shirt and holding a white paper coffee cup. Both are wearing seatbelts and looking forward.

entities.description: A white disposable paper coffee cup with a matching white plastic lid is held in a person's hand. The cup has a smooth, matte finish and a standard tapered cylindrical shape, with the hand gripping the lower portion of the cup.

A young Asian woman with long, straight black hair and bangs sits in the passenger seat of a car, wearing a white button-down shirt and a black seatbelt. She holds a white paper coffee cup with a lid in her hands and looks forward with a neutral expression.

A young man with curly brown hair sits in the driver's seat of a car, wearing a white button-down shirt and a green tie, with a seatbelt across his chest. He is looking forward with a slight smile, holding the steering wheel with his left hand, while a hand holding a white coffee cup is visible in the lower right corner.
